title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — NOTE 4 – Segment Reporting: sales to major customers (≥10% of consolidated net revenue)
key_points: The disclosure is framed as sales to major customers that accounted for at least 10% of the Company's consolidated net revenue, presented for the years ended December 31, 2022, December 25, 2021 and December 26, 2020.
FY2022: Customer A accounted for 16% of consolidated net revenue; Customer B was below 10% (marked with an asterisk).
FY2021: Customer A accounted for 14% and Customer B accounted for 11% of consolidated net revenue.
FY2020: both Customer A and Customer B were below 10% of consolidated net revenue.
The asterisk footnote is defined as 'Less than 10%'.
Customers are identified only by anonymous labels (Customer A, Customer B); no company names are disclosed.
The filing states that sales to customers A and B consisted of sales of products from the Gaming and Client segments, respectively.
This table sits within NOTE 4 – Segment Reporting of the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements (Part II, Item 8), immediately preceding NOTE 5 – Business Combinations.

title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — Item 1A Risk Factors: qualitative customer concentration statement
key_points: In the risk factors section, AMD states qualitatively that it expects a small number of customers to continue to account for a substantial part of its revenue.
The statement is used to explain increased risk of customers defaulting on or delaying payments owed to AMD.
This risk-factor passage provides no specific percentages and names no customers.
raw_excerpt: The risk related to our customers potentially defaulting on or delaying payments to us is increased because we expect that a small number of customers will continue to account for a substantial part of our revenue.

title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — NOTE 10 – Concentrations of Credit Risk: accounts receivable concentration
key_points: NOTE 10 – Concentrations of Credit Risk states that financial instruments potentially subjecting the Company to credit concentration consist primarily of investments in time deposits, available-for-sale debt securities and trade receivables.
As of December 25, 2021, two customers each accounted for approximately 20% and 15% of the total consolidated accounts receivable balance.

The Company states it does not believe the receivable balance from these customers represents a significant credit risk, based on past collection experience and review of their current credit quality.
This note measures concentration on an accounts-receivable basis, a different metric from the net-revenue percentages in Note 4.
raw_excerpt: …accounts receivable balance as of December 31, 2022. Two customers each accounted for approximately 20% and 15% of the total consolidated accounts receivable balance as of December 25, 2021. However, the Company does not believe the receivable balance from these customers represents a significant credit risk based on past collection experience and review of their current credit quality.

title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — Item 7 MD&A: segment revenue discussion (no customer-level concentration disclosure)
key_points: Item 7 Management's Discussion and Analysis discusses FY2022 results by the four reportable segments (Data Center, Client, Gaming, Embedded) rather than by customer.
FY2022 net revenue was $23.6 billion, an increase of 44% compared to 2021 net revenue of $16.4 billion.

The MD&A overview attributes growth to a 64% increase in Data Center segment revenue, a 21% increase in Gaming segment revenue, and the inclusion of Xilinx embedded product sales, partially offset by a 10% decrease in Client segment revenue.
No customer-concentration percentages or customer code names appear in the MD&A overview and results-of-operations passages retrieved.
raw_excerpt: Net revenue for 2022 was $23.6 billion, an increase of 44% compared to 2021 net revenue of $16.4 billion. The increase in net revenue was driven by a 64% increase in Data Center segment revenue primarily due to higher sales of our EPYC™ server processors, a 21% increase in Gaming segment revenue…

key_points: FY2022 segment net revenue: Data Center $6,043 million, Client $6,201 million, Gaming $6,805 million, Embedded $4,552 million, total $23,601 million.

title: AMD_2022_10K — Note 10 Concentrations of Credit Risk: accounts receivable concentration
key_points: AMD 在 Note 10 – Concentrations of Credit Risk 中单独披露应收账款集中度：截至 2021 年 12 月 25 日，两家客户分别约占合并应收账款余额的 20% 与 15%。
AMD 表示基于过往收款经验与对客户当前信用质量的复核，不认为该应收余额构成重大信用风险。
该附注将信用风险集中度的载体界定为定期存款、可供出售债务证券与贸易应收款等金融工具。

title: BOEING_2022_10K — Item 1A Risk Factors: customer financing portfolio concentration (qualitative contrast sample)
key_points: Boeing 在 Item 1A 风险因素中以定性方式披露客户融资组合集中度，风险标题为「A significant portion of our customer financing portfolio is concentrated among certain customers and in certain types of Boeing aircraft, which exposes us to concentration risks.」。

key_points: The Risk Factors section states that a small number of customers will continue to account for a substantial part of AMD's revenue in the future.

This risk-factor language is qualitative and does not quantify the concentration percentage.
